Double damage vs. hill, stone, frost, fire, cloud, and storm giants

Triple damage vs. one randomly determined dragon type

50% chance to extinguish nearby fire (includes wall of fire; excludes fireball/meteor swarm/flame strike)

Items.Name: Sword +4, Defender
SpecialAbilities: Can allocate up to +4 between attack and AC each round vs hand-held weapons
Items.Description: +4 Defender sword; wielder may allocate some/all of +4 to defense (AC) each round against hand-held weapon attacks.

Items.Name: Sword +5, Holy Avenger
SpecialAbilities: Paladin only full power; otherwise acts as +2
Paladin aura: 50% magic resistance in 5' radius
Items.Description: +5 Holy Avenger: full power in paladin hands; otherwise functions as +2. Paladin aura disrupts hostile magic and deals +10 vs chaotic evil.

Items.Name: Sword of Dancing
SpecialAbilities: Progressive melee bonus cycle +1/+2/+3/+4 by round, then repeats
Can be loosed to dance after melee cycles (manual mode pending)
Items.Description: Sword of Dancing with progressive +1 to +4 round-based combat bonuses.

SpecialAbilities: Severs neck/head on very high modified to-hit score
Sever thresholds: 20-23 normal, 21-23 large, 22-23 solid metal/stone
Some mutable/formless creatures cannot be decapitated
Items.Description: +3 Vorpal sword with decapitation on high modified hit score; some creatures are immune or survive decapitation.

Items.Name: Sword of Sharpness
SpecialAbilities: Counts as +3 weapon for magical hit requirements
Sever chance by modified to-hit score: 19-21 normal, 20-21 large, 21 stone/metal
Items.Description: +1 Sword of Sharpness with severing on very high modified hit scores; treated as +3 for what it can strike.

Items.Name: Sword of Life Stealing
SpecialAbilities: Natural 20 drains one level/hit-die equivalent life force
Wielder gains drained HP up to normal maximum
Items.Description: +2 sword that, on natural 20, drains one hit-die-equivalent life force from target and transfers HP to wielder (up to normal max).

Items.Name: Sword of Wounding
SpecialAbilities: Wounds inflict ongoing 1 HP/round per hit for up to 10 rounds
Damage from wounds cannot be healed by magical means
Items.Description: +1 Sword of Wounding: each hit causes ongoing blood loss (1 HP/round for up to 10 rounds per wound), suppresses regeneration, and magical healing cannot restore wound damage.
